question: Can independent 2026 reports identify a previously unindexed effective-skill/UI-refresh model risk for Midnight Prospecting quality eligibility without inventing drop rates?
taskSelection: Priority-122 Dragonflight diamond searches and TWW milling historical source approach repeatedly lacked current rank-specific completed casts; zero-delta pivot to distinct Midnight effective-skill context evidence.

sources.author: UNKNOWN_FROM_INDEX
sources.specialization: 30 points Prospecting Pro; Proficient Processor claimed; other ranks unknown
sources.interveningActions: Installed CraftSim and relogged; neither causation nor unchanged buffs/gear established

sources.author: Tarenis
sources.specialization: All relevant prospecting knowledge trees reportedly completed, exact ranks unknown
sources.priorDay: Able to produce R2 outputs without concentration

sources.claim: Several commenters state R2 ore to R2 gems without concentration is possible with sufficient skill, prospecting knowledge and blue equipment; concentration cannot be assumed for every queued cast.

interpretation.claim: Apparent recipe effective skill and quality threshold can be state-dependent or stale; test skill snapshot freshness and exact recipe/ore selection before assigning output-rank eligibility.
notProven: Any P, conditional yield bounds or zero-inclusive E
interpretation.patchNote: March and April 2026 reports are different publication epochs; exact cast epochs and builds unknown.

applicability.scope: Quality-rank and character-context model, not diamond-rate evidence

controlledMeasurement.question: For identical input itemID/rank and exact recipe on one character, does displayed effective skill or threshold change across selection, UI refresh, /reload, relog or addon toggle without changes in buffs/gear/spec?
capture: client build, UTC timestamp, exact input and output IDs/ranks
5-unit nominal batch and recipe spell ID
base/racial skill, each knowledge node rank, gear stats and buffs
displayed effective skill and threshold before/after each transition
addon enabled state, screenshots and event logs
completed casts and output rank/zero events only if actually tested
actual input consumed and separate refunds, concentration spent
controlledMeasurement.holdout: Repeat on second character or session; no in-sample proof of formula.

blockers: No raw before/after screenshots, logs or client build
Unknown buff/gear and selector changes between reports
No exact cast counts, output histograms or refunds
